about: Outside Scurrius's lair in the Varrock Sewers, with rune melee gear, 70 combat, 43 Prayer and lobsters.
notes: Scurrius step 1. On the sewer side of the broken bars (Scurrius.OUTSIDE): Climb-through (normal) goes into the public lair, Climb-through (private) into one of the player's own. The loadout is ours, not a live one (the Wiki's Strategies page suggests level 60 gear).
